about: Two buns on top, made on WarriorF's own head (Moti, 2026-11-18): her head drawn by sheet.py, the hair painted on by Iris (front and side), Tripo given both; the whole head with the hair on. hair.py cuts the hair out by its paint and lays it on her by its skin (haircut.py); each bun a lock held all round its base (locks.py), firm, moved by Forge (HairLocks). Known: white specks on the buns' backs (Tripo's), to be made again.
